newsitem.title: USA: Fed cites Boston branch of National Bank of Greece.
newsitem.headline: Fed cites Boston branch of National Bank of Greece.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Board on Friday announced a cease and desist order against the National Bank of Greece and its branch in Boston.
They were assessed a $300,000 fine, the Fed said.
The Fed said the order and fine were for alleged unsafe and unsound practices and violations relating to the branch's compliance with the Bank Secrecy act.
It said the bank and its branch did not admit to any of the charges in the order, issued by the Fed with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. and the state of Massachusetts.
